groups.condition: The array is at the nesting depth accepted by parsing.
groups.capability: Print the array without rejecting its depth.
groups.consequence: Printing fails solely because of array nesting depth.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: array printing is a distinct target operation.

groups.condition: The object is at the nesting depth accepted by parsing.
groups.capability: Print the object without rejecting its depth.
groups.consequence: Printing fails solely because of object nesting depth.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: object printing is a distinct target operation.

groups.operation: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw child within an array or object.
groups.condition: cJSON_Raw children are supported print inputs under a valid setup.
groups.capability: Allow a valid input and setup to reach child printing; reachability depends on cJSON.c::parse_value and the cJSON.c::cJSON_CreateRaw contract.
groups.consequence: Raw-child printing cannot be reached through a supported setup.
groups.equivalence_reason: Singleton: this concerns input reachability, distinct from array and object depth printing.
